facts.fact: The home affairs ministry is preparing to launch e-ID smart cards in September 2026, with banks to authenticate a customer by matching a fingerprint to the card chip and the Prime Minister's office describing identity federation ('one credential for all').

facts.fact: The home affairs ministry is preparing to launch a new e-ID smart card storing biometric and demographic data in September 2026, with a unique digital identifier separate from the existing identity number, per ministry and Office of the Prime Minister officials.
